name: Sampling Feature
abstract: OMS alignment: implements the ISO 19156:2023 (OGC Topic 20 / O&M 3.0) `sam-cpt/Sampling` requirement class for `sosa:Sampling`. This building block defines a GeoJSON feature for a SOSA Sampling - the Act of carrying out a Sampling Procedure to create or transform one or more samples. Uses the properties defined in the Sampling Properties schema.
